not_observed_here: This account has never traded and cannot place an order without a whitelisted static IP, so no row of this shape has arrived here. The shape is Dhan's published specification, which is complete for both request and response; the VALUES are Dhan's own sample values.
why_it_matters: Dhan validates in order -- quantity, then the IP, then the instrument -- so a payload missing a required field never reaches the checks that matter and fails with 'quantity is required' instead of the real reason. This is the field list to build against.
